title: Musk: Third Person Receives Computer-Brain Connection from Neuralink
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Businessman Elon Musk said a third person has had a special electronic device directly connected to their brain.
sentences.zh: 商人Elon Musk说,第三人有一个与大脑直接相连的特别电子装置。

sentences.en: The unidentified person received an implant from Musk’s company Neuralink, which makes devices that link the human brain to computers.
sentences.zh: 不明身份者从Musk的公司Neuralink得到一个植入装置,使人类大脑与计算机连接起来。

sentences.en: Neuralink is one of many groups working to connect the human nervous system to machines.
sentences.zh: Neuralink是许多致力于将人类神经系统与机器连接起来的团体之一。

sentences.en: On the social media service X, which he owns, Musk said: "We've got...three humans with Neuralinks and all are working well."
sentences.zh: 在他拥有的社交媒体服务X上,Musk说,“我们有三个人和Neuralinks一起工作,一切都很顺利。”

sentences.en: Neuralink announced its first brain implant one year ago.
sentences.zh: Neuralink一年前宣布了它的第一次大脑植入。

sentences.en: Recently, Musk said the company has improved its devices.
sentences.zh: 最近,Musk说公司改进了设备。

sentences.en: Musk also said Neuralink hopes to implant the experimental devices in 20 to 30 more people this year.
sentences.zh: Musk还说Neuralink希望在今年再植入20到30人。

sentences.en: The second patient reportedly has a spinal cord injury and got the implant last summer.
sentences.zh: 据报,第二名病人去年夏天被植入脊椎。

sentences.en: The person was playing video games with the help of the device and learning how to use design software.
sentences.zh: 此人在设备的帮助下玩电子游戏,并学习如何使用设计软件。

sentences.en: The first patient, also paralyzed after a spinal cord injury, said it helped him play video games and chess.
sentences.zh: 第一个在脊髓受伤后瘫痪的病人说,这有助于他玩电子游戏和象棋。

sentences.en: Many other companies and research groups are working on similar projects.
sentences.zh: 许多其他公司和研究小组也在从事类似的项目。

sentences.en: Two studies published last year in the New England Journal of Medicine describe how brain-computer interfaces, known as BCIs, helped people with Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) communicate better.
sentences.zh: 去年在《新英格兰医学杂志》上发表的两份研究报告描述了大脑-计算机界面(称为BCIs)如何帮助患子宫颈硬化(ALS)的人更好地沟通。

sentences.en: ALS is a nervous system disease that affects cells in the brain and spinal cord.
sentences.zh: ALS是一种神经系统疾病,影响脑细胞和脊髓。

sentences.en: Others working on brain-computer interface technology Nature magazine reported last September that there were published results from 28 trials worldwide of BCIs over the past 25 years.
sentences.zh: 其他从事大脑-计算机接口技术的作者《自然》杂志去年9月报道说,过去25年来,全世界有28个BCI的试验结果已经发表。

sentences.en: Rajesh Rao is co-director of the Center for Neurotechnology at the University of Washington.
sentences.zh: Rajesh Rao是华盛顿大学神经技术中心的共同主任。

sentences.en: Rao said that many research laboratories have already shown that humans can control computer cursors using BCIs.
sentences.zh: Rao说,许多研究实验室已经表明,人类可以使用BCI控制计算机光标。

sentences.en: Rao said Neuralink might be different from the others in two ways.
sentences.zh: Rao说Neuralink在两种方式上可能与其他人不同。

sentences.en: First, the surgery to implant the device is the first to use a robot to implant flexible electrical connectors into a human brain to record brain signals and to control devices.
sentences.zh: 首先,植入该装置的手术是首先使用机器人将灵活的电子连接器植入人类大脑,以记录大脑信号和控制设备。

sentences.en: Second, those connectors might record from more parts of the brain than interfaces from other research efforts.
sentences.zh: 其次,这些连接器可能从大脑中记录到更多的部分,而不是从其他研究工作中记录到的界面。

sentences.en: Rao said other companies such as Synchron, Blackrock Neurotech and Onward Medical are carrying out BCI tests on people using methods that are different from Neuralink.
sentences.zh: Rao说,其他公司,如Synchron、Blackrock Neurotech和前方医疗公司,正在对使用不同于Neuralink的方法的人进行BCI测试。

sentences.en: Benefits of BCIs Marco Baptista is chief scientific officer of the Christopher & Dana Reeve Foundation.
sentences.zh: BCIs Marco Baptista的福利是Christopher & Dana Reeve基金会的首席科学官员。

sentences.en: He called BCI technology "very exciting" with possible benefits to people with paralysis.
sentences.zh: 他称BCI科技“非常令人兴奋”,

sentences.en: Through clinical tests, "we'll be able to see what's going to be the winning approach," he said.
sentences.zh: 通过临床测试,“我们将能看到什么是赢家的方法,”他说。

sentences.en: "It's a little early to know." A clinical trial follows established rules on how to design an experiment involving human subjects.
sentences.zh: 临床试验遵循既定规则 如何设计涉及人体实验物的实验

sentences.en: How are BCIs tested and supervised? Neuralink announced in 2023 that it had received permission from U.S. officials to begin testing its device in people.
sentences.zh: 2023年,Neuralink宣布,它得到了美国官员的许可,可以开始在人体内测试其装置。

sentences.en: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is responsible for approving the sale of medical devices.
sentences.zh: 食品和药品管理局(FDA)负责批准医疗设备的销售。

sentences.en: Dr. Rita Redberg studies high-risk devices at the University of California, San Francisco.
sentences.zh: Rita Redberg博士在旧金山加利福尼亚大学研究高风险装置。

sentences.en: Redberg said that most medical devices go on the market without clinical trials.
sentences.zh: Redberg说,大多数医疗设备在没有临床试验的情况下上市。

sentences.en: However, high-risk devices that are seeking approval from the FDA before they go on the market need what is called an "investigational device exemption ."
sentences.zh: 然而,高风险装置在上市前要征得食品药品管理局的批准,需要所谓的“调查装置豁免”。

sentences.en: Neuralink says it has this exemption. I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: Neuralink说它有这种豁免。我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

sentences.en: Laura Ungar reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: Laura Ungar为美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.
sentences.zh: 吉尔・罗宾斯改编了它 学习英语。
